summary: Enhance your finance skills with our Data Science and Analytics training course. Learn to leverage data for informed decision-making and strategic insights.
lede: Data Science and Analytics for Finance helps you turn complex financial data into validated analysis, interpretable forecasts, risk insights, and decision-ready reporting. Using the CRISP-DM lifecycle, you will work with SQL, Excel, Power Query, Python, pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, Monte Carlo simulation, Power BI, and DAX to prepare data, test assumptions, evaluate models, and build dashboards. The course also addresses the controls that make finance analytics reliable, including access, review, reconciliation, approval, explainability, and data governance. Through guided coding, model evaluation, dashboard design, and management reporting, you will learn to work with incomplete records, inconsistent account structures, restricted access, model risk, and competing reporting deadlines.
audienceIntro: This finance analytics training is designed for professionals who prepare, analyze, control, interpret, or communicate financial information and need a structured introduction to data-driven finance workflows.
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course assumes working familiarity with financial statements, budgets, transactions, or finance reporting. Prior Python, SQL, or statistical modelling experience is optional, but guided coding is required during the course. You should bring a laptop capable of running a modern web browser, JupyterLab, Python, and SQLite; Power BI Desktop and Excel support designated labs where organizational licensing and device compatibility permit. Advanced machine learning, explainability, and production deployment receive conceptual awareness or operational application coverage rather than technical engineering depth.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
